derivation: from an unused root meaning to journey;
def: a ewe (the females being the predominant element of a flock) (as a good traveller)

words.word: have i been with thee thy ewes

occurrences.text: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
words: have I been with thee thy ewes

occurrences.text: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.
He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
